functions.name: fin_sma
functions.reason: averages supplied rows and ignores the period argument
functions.replacement: use avg with an explicit SQL window matching the desired lookback

functions.name: fin_wma
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean without linearly increasing weights and ignores period
functions.replacement: assign chronological weights in SQL before aggregating

functions.name: fin_dema
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a double exponential moving average
functions.replacement: compute two ordered EMA stages and combine them explicitly

functions.name: fin_tema
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a triple exponential moving average
functions.replacement: compute three ordered EMA stages and combine them explicitly

functions.name: fin_trima
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a triangularly weighted moving average
functions.replacement: assign triangular chronological weights explicitly

functions.name: fin_t3
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean and ignores period and volume factor
functions.replacement: use a validated external T3 implementation

functions.name: fin_kama
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean and ignores adaptive smoothing parameters
functions.replacement: use a validated external Kaufman adaptive moving average implementation

functions.name: fin_hma
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a Hull moving average
functions.replacement: compute the staged weighted moving averages explicitly

functions.name: fin_linearreg
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of an endpoint regression estimate
functions.replacement: use regr_slope and regr_intercept over an explicit chronological axis

functions.name: fin_linearreg_intercept
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a regression intercept
functions.replacement: use regr_intercept with an explicit chronological axis

functions.name: fin_tsf
functions.reason: returns an arithmetic mean instead of a regression forecast
functions.replacement: estimate slope and intercept explicitly before forecasting

functions.name: fin_apo
functions.reason: returns a constant placeholder instead of exponential moving-average spread
functions.replacement: compute fast and slow moving averages explicitly in SQL

functions.name: fin_aroon
functions.reason: returns fixed placeholder values instead of lookback high/low positions
functions.replacement: compute high/low lookback positions explicitly in SQL

functions.name: fin_aroonosc
functions.reason: returns a constant placeholder instead of Aroon oscillator
functions.replacement: compute Aroon up/down explicitly and subtract them

functions.name: fin_linearreg_slope
functions.reason: returns NULL until rolling/windowed regression slope support is added
functions.replacement: use DuckDB regr_slope over the desired window

functions.name: fin_macd
functions.reason: returns zero MACD fields instead of exponential moving-average signals
functions.replacement: compute fast, slow, and signal EMAs explicitly before using the result

functions.name: fin_ppo
functions.reason: returns a constant placeholder instead of percentage price oscillator
functions.replacement: compute fast and slow moving averages explicitly in SQL

functions.name: fin_portfolio_optimize
functions.reason: returns equal weights without solving the supplied optimization objective
functions.replacement: use an external optimizer and validate the resulting weights in SQL

functions.name: fin_portfolio_optimize_table
functions.reason: assigns equal weights to distinct assets without using their return history
functions.replacement: use an external optimizer and validate the resulting weights in SQL

functions.name: fin_bootstrap_curve
functions.reason: treats every quoted rate as a zero rate instead of bootstrapping instrument cash flows
functions.replacement: bootstrap instrument-specific discount factors externally before interpolating in SQL

functions.name: fin_curve_bootstrap
functions.reason: alias of fin_bootstrap_curve that treats every quoted rate as a zero rate
functions.replacement: bootstrap instrument-specific discount factors externally before interpolating in SQL

functions.name: fin_garch_fit
functions.reason: returns fixed omega alpha and beta (only p=1, q=1, normal accepted) rather than fitting a GARCH model
functions.replacement: fit GARCH parameters externally before forecasting in SQL

functions.name: fin_fama_macbeth
functions.reason: runs per-date regressions on the first factor only without second-stage inference or lag corrections
functions.replacement: compute reviewed cross-sectional regressions and second-stage inference explicitly
